codeReview.summary: Implementation covers most scoped behavior, but two blocking parity defects remain in traversal/flag semantics.

issues.description: Ignore rules are pushed per directory (`engine.push_directory(dir)`) but never popped when recursion unwinds, so ignore patterns from one subtree leak into later siblings. This breaks default ignore-stack semantics; repro: creating `a/.ignore` with `*.txt` also suppresses `b/keep.txt` in rust-ag while baseline ag still returns it.

`-r` cannot override `-n`: walker only checks `opts.no_recurse`, while parser sets `opts.recurse` separately (`opts.rs` lines 285-286 and 398-399) but that field is never honored. Baseline ag follows last-flag semantics (`-n -r` recurses), rust-ag stays non-recursive.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker explicitly suggested documenting parity-matrix group tagging, but the skill still does not mention updating `manifests/scenarios.json` groups when adding new parity-runner groups.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.skillFeedback.suggestedChanges requests this update; `.factory/skills/rewrite-worker/SKILL.md` Work Procedure has no step about scenario group tags.

sharedStateObservations.observation: A commonly used rust parity-matrix command is not represented in services.yaml.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Worker verification used `python3 scripts/parity/run_matrix.py --target rust-ag --group core-ignore-recursion`, but `.factory/services.yaml` only defines baseline parity commands (`parity_baseline_smoke`, `parity_edge_cases_baseline`).
